resolutions.reachability: No inbound WebSocket server is exposed. This branch is retained by jayson/isomorphic-ws and viem; wallet and RPC imports are regression-tested.
resolutions.removalCondition: Remove after every direct parent requires ws >=7.5.11 or no longer installs ws 7.

resolutions.reachability: The server transport is HTTP/stdio, but ethers and viem export optional WebSocket clients. Loading the wallet/RPC stack is regression-tested against the patched release.
resolutions.removalCondition: Remove after TronWeb/ethers and viem resolve to ws >=8.21.0 without an override.

resolutions.reachability: Reachable through SunKit -> Universal Router -> PancakeSwap/Solana utility code during route construction; patched at the dependency boundary and exercised by SUNSWAP tests.
resolutions.removalCondition: Remove after the Universal Router dependency tree requires bn.js >=5.2.3.

resolutions.reachability: jayson calls uuid.v4() without a caller-provided buffer; the vulnerable v3/v5/v6 buffer path is not used. Automatic JSON-RPC ID generation is regression-tested with uuid 11.
resolutions.removalCondition: Remove after jayson requires uuid >=11.1.1 or the Solana dependency is removed.

resolutions.reachability: Reachable from the MCP SDK Express transport. Middleware construction is regression-tested and the fixed minor release is forced.
resolutions.removalCondition: Remove after the MCP SDK/Express tree requires body-parser >=2.3.0.
